Gunfire nearby
Two shots rang out. The beetles ahead scattered, but the gunfire drew the attention of watchers in the distance.
Gunfire rolled across the wasteland. The swarm before you withdrew into the cracks in the stones, but something moved farther off.
Detour quietly
The team used a little extra supplies to skirt the hollow without drawing attention.
Boots sank into the wet mud. Holding their breath, the team crept around the edge of the hollow.
The team retreated to the edge of the hollow.
Drive off beetles with smoke
Thick smoke from damp wood drove the beetles back. The way is clear for now, but they'll crawl out again.
Thick smoke spread across the hollow. The beetles retreated beneath the rubble.
Record the habits of the gray-shelled beetles
The beetles freeze when the temperature drops to its lowest. From now on, the team will cross the hollow only at the coldest hours.
You watched from behind the rubble for a long time. When the cold set in, the beetles froze one by one.
Force a way through the beetle hollow
One person was bitten, and the food sack was torn open, spilling {变量1} servings of food.
The beetles swarmed. One team member's lower leg was bloodied, and their mandibles sheared through a sack of dry rations.
The team left everything here untouched.
The freight board on the station waiting room wall was frozen at the last departure. The destination column still read “Mars.” On the back of a repair plan, someone had marked a pump station.
Brought back the pump station route map and {变量1} scrap{分支2}
; what they couldn't carry will have to stay on the platform.
Pried off {变量1} scrap. There should be about {变量2} more to salvage on the platform.
Pump station surveyed
The electrical cabinet is dead, but the mechanical bypass is intact. Repairs require water purification knowledge and repair parts.
The electrical cabinet lost power long ago, but the mechanical bypass still works. Bring wood and scrap next time to make repairs.
Pump station running again
Following the workshop's trial notes, you connected the filter pipe. The pump station is now a water stop on the outskirts, and the settlement can set up supply outposts along the pipeline.
The impeller started turning again. The team can refill their water whenever they pass by.
Canteens filled (+{变量1}).
You carefully rolled up the paper strips and wrapped them in oilcloth. They're heavy, but if you carry them back, the workshop can learn the ways of this wasteland.
Dismantle the old weather station
The instruments were stripped for scrap, and the damp paper strips scattered across the ground, impossible to piece together again.
Salvaged {变量1} scrap. The waterlogged paper strips were trampled into the mud, blurred beyond recognition.
Salvaged another {变量1} scrap.
Survivors in the storeroom
The team set aside 3 rations. The old surveyor sketched the locations of the pump station and beetle hollow on the ground.
The old surveyor took the rations and marked the pump station's location in the ash with a branch. Then he added, “The beetles in the hollow fear the cold, and smoke drives them off.”
The people inside didn't open the door. They spoke through the crack: beetles in the southwest hollow, and the pump station farther west.
Invite the people in the storeroom
They agreed to come, once the settlement has three beds to spare.
The old surveyor said he and his two apprentices would move once you had three beds free and food to spare in the pot.
Storeroom residents move in
The people from the storeroom move into the settlement
The old surveyor settled in the settlement with his two apprentices. He still remembered the old city's road numbers.
